name: memory
description: Python MCP memory server : promote facts to long-term memory, list/review memories, manage profile memory files, and generate channel summaries. Python equivalent of the Rust memory plugin.

config_schema.label: Database URL
config_schema.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for memory storage

config_schema.label: OMNI_DIR
config_schema.description: Data directory for wiki memory files

config_schema.label: Summarize After Days
config_schema.description: Trigger summary after this many days of completed threads (trigger count = days * 2)

config_schema.label: Summary Window
config_schema.description: Number of threads to include in each summary window

config_schema.label: Channel Summary Tokens
config_schema.description: Max tokens for channel summary generation
